parallels.note: I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.

translations.web: Yahweh, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
translations.bsb: O LORD, be gracious to us! We wait for You. Be our strength every morning and our salvation in time of trouble.
translations.kjv: O LORD, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
translations.asv: O Jehovah, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou our arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
